source:
@@U00450@@
If ever I lie down in a bed of ease, let that be my end! If ever you so delude me with your flattery into feeling self-satisfied, or deceive me with pleasure, let that day be my last! This is my wager!

@@U00452@@
Done!

@@U00454@@
And done again! My hand! If ever I say to the moment: “Linger awhile, you are so fair!” then cast me in chains, for I'll be glad to die! Let the bell toll for me then; then you'll be freed of your service; let the clock stop, let its hands fall, and time for me will be at an end!

@@U00456@@
Consider well what you're doing; it wont be forgotten.

@@U00458@@
And that’s your right. This has been no rash decision. Once I stand still, once I begin to stagnate, I’m a slave. Whose makes no difference, yours or another's.

@@U00460@@
There’s a faculty dinner tonight. I'll be there, and begin my service as your servant.
translation:
@@U00450@@
如果我能安逸地躺在床上，那就让这成为我的终结吧！如果你用你的奉承来欺骗我，让我感到自我满足，或者用快乐来欺骗我，那就让那一天成为我的最后一天吧！这是我的赌注！

@@U00452@@
完成！

@@U00454@@
又完成了！我的手！如果我对那一刻说：“再呆一会儿，你真公平！”然后把我锁起来，因为我会很乐意去死！那么就让丧钟为我敲响吧；那么你将被解除服务；让时钟停止，让指针落下，我的时间就结束了！

@@U00456@@
好好考虑一下你在做什么；它不会被忘记。

@@U00458@@
这是你的权利。这并不是一个鲁莽的决定。一旦我停滞不前，一旦我开始停滞不前，我就是一个奴隶。无论是你的还是别人的，谁的都没有区别。

@@U00460@@
今晚有一个教师晚宴。我会在那里，开始为您服务。
